column2: All Israel is summoned to hear, learn and keep doing the ordinances and judgments spoken today; all three responses remain.
The covenant is with you at Horeb in the selected second-person wording, not harmonized to us.
The contrast is fathers versus all those alive here today; the selected you and your remain throughout.
Face-to-face speech occurs on the mountain from fire, preserving both intimacy and setting without explanatory reconciliation.
Moses mediates the Lord's words because Israel fears the fire and does not ascend; He said resumes the divine speech after the parenthesis.
The Lord identifies Himself through deliverance from Egypt and bondage; the human addressee receives ordinary you.
Other gods before the Lord are prohibited, retaining the personal before Me formulation.
Idols and likenesses across heaven, earth and waters are prohibited; all three realms remain.
Worship and service are both forbidden, with jealousy and repayment through the third and fourth generations of haters retained.
Mercy to thousands applies to those loving and keeping ordinances; no unexpressed generations is inserted after thousands.
The name must not be taken in vain; hold guiltless conveys the selected cleansing verb's judicial force in this warning.
column3: The judicial rendering of katharizo is provisional and should be distinguished from ritual cleansing contexts, not treated as a global equivalent.

column2: Keeping and sanctifying the Sabbath follow the Lord's prior command, preserving both actions.
Six working days include all work, with the sentence continuing into the seventh-day contrast.
Propose livestock for the generic animal category after ox and beast of burden. Plural sons, singular daughter, both slave groups, the sojourner and equal rest all remain.
Egyptian household slavery and deliverance by mighty hand and uplifted arm motivate Sabbath keeping and sanctification; the selected final sanctification clause remains.
Honouring both parents serves welfare and long life in the given land; the command's prior divine authority remains.
Adultery is prohibited here, preserving its selected position before the murder command.
Murder is prohibited here, without reordering it ahead of 5:17.
The theft prohibition remains brief and unexpanded.
Bear false witness expresses the cognate Greek action and false-testimony object in ordinary English; the neighbour remains the protected party.
Propose livestock for the generic category after ox and beast of burden. Both coveting prohibitions and wife, house, field, slaves and every possession remain in order.
The entire assembly hears amid fire, darkness, gloom, tempest and great voice; no further words are added, and two stone tablets are given to Moses.
All tribal heads and elders approach after hearing from fire while the mountain burns, preserving the audience and sequence.
They acknowledge glory, voice from fire and human survival after divine speech; no additional greatness clause is imported.
The plea not to die and fear of further hearing remain, with the great fire as the stated danger.
The rhetorical question asks what flesh can hear the living God from fire and live; the selected bodily description remains.
Moses is asked to hear and report everything, and the people promise to hear and do; every link in the mediation remains.
The Lord hears their words and declares all they said right, retaining the repeated report of hearing.
O that expresses the selected wish for a heart that fears and keeps commands always, for their and their sons' lasting welfare.
The people are sent back to houses, preserving selected houses rather than substituting tents.
Moses remains with the Lord to receive commandments, ordinances and judgments for teaching and practice in the given land.
Careful performance excludes turning right or left, preserving both directions.
Walking the whole commanded way leads to rest, welfare and long days; selected give you rest is retained rather than changed to live.
Commandments, ordinances and judgments are taught for practice in the inherited land; the implicit teacher Moses is naturally supplied as me.
Fear, all ordinances and commands, sons and grandsons, lifelong observance and long days all remain.
Hearing and careful practice serve welfare and great increase under the promise of milk-and-honey land.
The full wilderness/exodus preface remains within this unit before Hear, O Israel and the confession of the one Lord; it is not omitted as unfamiliar.
Love involves all heart, all soul and all strength, with the selected threefold repetition preserved.
Today's commanded words belong in both heart and soul; the selected soul clause remains.
Teaching sons and speaking at home, on the way, lying down and rising all remain.
The hand sign and immovable presence before the eyes remain; the selected adjective is not replaced by a familiar object name.
Writing is commanded on doorposts of houses and gates; the plural address and plural buildings remain reflected in your houses and gates.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are all named, and the promised large good cities are explicitly unbuilt by the recipients.
Unfilled houses, unhewn cisterns and unplanted vineyards and olive groves precede eating and fullness; all gift contrasts remain.
The warning against forgetting identifies the Lord as deliverer from Egypt and bondage.
Fear, service, attachment and oath by His name are all retained; the selected cleave clause is not dropped.
Following neighbouring nations' other gods is prohibited, preserving the local-nations qualification.
The jealous Lord is among Israel; wrath and destruction from earth's face are the warned consequences.
The testing prohibition recalls Testing by its translated selected name, retaining the repeated test language.
Diligent keeping represents the emphatic selected construction, with commandments, testimonies and ordinances all retained.
Pleasing and good conduct leads to welfare, entry and inheritance under the ancestral oath.
Driving out all enemies remains part of the promised action, without losing all or the connection to prior speech.
The future child's question names testimonies, ordinances and judgments and asks about the Lord's command to us.
The answer recalls household slavery to Pharaoh and deliverance by mighty hand and uplifted arm; both power images remain.
Great and grievous signs and wonders occur in Egypt against Pharaoh and his house before the witnesses; both adjectives remain.
Bringing out serves bringing in and giving this promised land, preserving the repeated movement contrast.
Observance and fear serve continuing welfare and life as today, with all ordinances retained.
Mercy remains for selected eleemosyne, linked conditionally to careful performance before the Lord, not replaced by familiar righteousness.
column3: The precise sense and direction of mercy in this construction require fuller lexical and syntactic review; the inherited wording is provisional.

column2: All seven nations are named in selected order, with their number, size and greater strength preserved.
Delivery, striking and utter destruction precede prohibitions of covenant and mercy; the violent command is neither softened nor expanded.
Intermarriage is prohibited in both directions, daughter to his son and his daughter to your son.
He turns your son away from Me and the son serves other gods; the selected masculine pronouns and ensuing divine wrath remain.
Altars, pillars, sacred groves and carved divine images receive four distinct removal actions; selected groves is not silently changed to poles.
Holiness and divine choice ground Israel's status as a people for His own possession above the nations.
Preference and choice are expressly not due to numbers, since Israel is the fewest; both selected choosing verbs remain.
Love and oath-keeping motivate deliverance and redemption from Pharaoh, with mighty hand and uplifted arm both retained.
The faithful God keeps covenant and mercy with loving command-keepers to a thousand generations; here generations is explicit.
Repayment to haters' faces is repeated, with destruction and absence of delay preserved.
Today's commandments, ordinances and judgments are to be kept and done; all categories remain.
Hearing, keeping and doing precede the promised keeping of covenant and mercy sworn to the fathers.
Love, blessing and increase extend to offspring, grain, wine, oil, cattle herds and sheep flocks; cattle here renders the specifically bovine term and is retained.
Propose livestock for the generic ktene. The blessing excludes barren male and female among both people and livestock, not just bovines.
Every infirmity is removed, Egypt's grievous diseases are withheld and laid on all haters; the contrasted recipients remain.
The selected object of consume is all the nations' spoil, not the nations themselves; eye-pity and service of their gods are separately prohibited.
column3: The referent of them and the precise obstacle/snare sense of skolon need further review; the selected spoil object is not harmonized away.

column2: The inward question compares this nation's numbers with I, preserving the collective singular perspective.
Fear is prohibited and emphatic remembrance is directed to all done to Pharaoh and all Egyptians.
Trials, signs, wonders, mighty hand and uplifted arm remain as the precedent for the Lord's action against feared nations; your God and our God remain distinct.
The hornets are sent until remaining and hidden enemies are removed; both groups remain.
column3: The precise insect identification is provisional; this pass does not claim zoological verification.

column2: Selected you shall not be wounded remains, grounded in the great and mighty God's presence, rather than being changed to do not be afraid.
Gradual removal is repeated as little by little; rapid removal is excluded lest land become desolate and wild beasts multiply.
Delivery and great destruction continue until complete destruction, preserving the emphatic repeated wording.
Kings are delivered and their name perishes from that place; no one can resist until destruction is complete.
Propose from them for upon them to represent the selected apo phrase without adding a location for the silver and gold. Burning images, rejecting gain and avoiding stumbling remain.
Bringing the abomination home risks sharing its ban; emphatic rejection and abhorrence are both retained.
